evidence.excerpt: In this study, we examine whether a general shell can outperform specialized tools on enterprise tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare five tool interfaces on TheAgentCompany and APEX-Agents using Opus-4.8 and GPT-5.5: typed tools, typed tools plus bash, bash alone, bash with persistent agent-synthesized tools, and programmatic tool calling (PTC), which runs programs whose actions are restricted to a typed tool catalog.
